limitations: Source review and existing evidence verification are not independent security sign-off or hostile-process heap/RSS qualification.
Object callers must provide allocation-bounded trusted data; own-key reflection cost on preexisting objects is explicitly not claimed constant.
Canonical key sorting is a serialization rule; JavaScript enumerates integer-like object keys specially, and consumers must use the declared canonical serializer.
Full semantic decision evidence, service/SQL/HTTP loaders, operation deadlines, memory capacity and runtime activation remain separate unfinished work.
independent_review.qualification: Independent assistant-agent static review and existing evidence readback; not a human sign-off or new test execution.

tested_semantics: Raw and canonical UTF-8 bounds at8388608 bytes,262144 nodes and depth32; whitespace is charged to raw bytes and property names to canonical bytes.
Sorted code-unit canonical keys, ordered arrays, exact safe integral decimal normalization, no negative zero or malformed Unicode.
Duplicate decoded keys fail before overwrite; escaped aliases, unpaired surrogates and malformed JSON fail closed.
Proxies rejected before traps, accessors rejected without invocation, exotic/inherited/symbol/sparse/extra-array values refused.
Cycles rejected; shared references copied and charged per occurrence; successful data/wrapper/metrics detached and deeply frozen.
Literal __proto__/constructor keys preserved as data without inherited setters; supplied metrics never override measured counters.

preserved_history.interpretation: All preexisting public JSON reports and the admission attempts/review remain byte-identical. The typecheck failure retains its original source and result.
